MRIO.zip.citation: Huang, S. et al., European multi regional input output data for 2008-2018, Scientific Data 10 (2023)
MRIO.zip.why: the technical-validation set carries NINE survey-based Austrian NUTS-2 tables (Rokicki et al. 2021) with both sides of interregional trade by sector, plus Finnish and Scottish regional tables. OQ-R-02 closed on ONE region; these are the cases that say whether delta = 0.20 generalises. The 272-region MRIO files are estimates, not ground truth, and are used for structure rather than for scoring.
MRIO.zip.side_files_note: Final_demand_2018.xlsx and TAXSUB_VA_2018.xlsx were on disk from 2026-09-01 and used from then on, but were missing from `extracted` until 2026-09-11. Confirmed that day against the deposit itself by reading only the zip's central directory (an HTTP range request for the last 4 MB): both are under Data/ with uncompressed sizes 241,525 and 157,877 bytes, equal to the files here, as is MRIO_2018_272regions.xlsx at 34,814,567. The deposit holds the same three files for every year 2008-2017.
MRIO.zip.note: the archive and every workbook extracted from it are gitignored: 317 MB against a 33 MB data/ and a 74 MB .git. What is tracked is this file, so the payload is re-obtainable from the URL and checkable against the hash.
